lines: This lesson teaches five notes: C, D, E, F and G on the top two strings.
Practice them slowly, and you'll be ready for the next step.

scenes.heading: Five notes
lines: Let's start with five simple notes.
On string 2, press fret 1 for C and fret 3 for D.
On string 1, play the open string for E, fret 1 for F, and fret 3 for G.
Use finger 1 for fret 1 and finger 3 for fret 3.

scenes.title: C D E F G
lines: Let's play five simple notes that climb up the strings.
Start with C and D on string 2, then move to E, F and G on string 1.

scenes.title: G F E D C
lines: Watch the tab and listen to each note.
Now you know five notes on the top two strings.
Play them while the app listens — it's your turn to make music.
